subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh one of the open fork candidates or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but the existing target-repo attempts are closed unmerged and the open fork PRs are conflict-marked, so automation should not open another fix branch until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the best open fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new automated branch until a contributor refreshes a candidate with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path blame and current-main authorship make this the strongest available owner for choosing the implementation path.
